profile.jobTitle: Lead Singer, Keyboardist and Bassist for MACHIN3
profile.summary:
After a long career as a professional musician singing for bands such as The Limos, Geri's Hat Tricks, A Rival and others, was highlighted by a Grammy Nomination and appearance on VH1's Cover Wars hosted by Paul Shaffer in 2001, Eric went to work for Apple as a computer technician in 2004.

In 2006 Eric was "The Mac Guy" on a popular Saturday computer radio show on 1360 KKTX in Corpus Christi which led to him to start his own IT Consulting / Web Development business which provides IT services and custom web applications to Apple/Mac based Law Firms.

Eric continues to play music professionally and also acts in independent films.

His latest film is an independent horror film called, "Deviant Behavior".  Deviant Behavior is out on Blue Ray and digital streaming sites such as Amazon Prime, Tubi TV and The Killer Movie Channel.  Eric plays the lead role in Deviant Behavior which also features two original casts members of the 1974 horror classic, "The Texas Chainsaw Massacre".  Eric also wrote and performed all the music featured in the film and on the sound track which is available on most music streaming services such as Apple Music, Amazon Music and YouTube music to name a few.



Besides owning his own successful IT business, Eric is also the Web Developer for Absolute Communications and the lead singer and bassist of the band, MACHIN3.
